decisions.decision: Checkout, refunds and reporting share one order-event format, defined by the order events component.
decisions.reason: All three capabilities produce or consume the same events about an order (the epic's shared need, BR-4 and BR-5).
rejected: Each capability defines its own event shape.
obligations: Every change to an order emits one order event (BR-4).
Every order event carries the order id and a sequence number, and a consumer ignores an event it has already seen (BR-5).
decisions.compatibility: Changes are additive only. Removing or renaming anything is a new format version that every bound element adopts together.
